name: Proving Grounds 21: The Sunken Causeway. An old stone road through a foggy mire, by day: the slow wading shoulders run beside it, a raised shrine plaza astride it is the high ground everyone must cross, two breaches slow the way, and it ends at a ruined gatehouse (steps in front, a slumped ramp on the north flank) where something keeps a throne of skulls.
